Priya R: Quick sync — I've published a draft for the private-deploy preflight runway focusing on BGP handoff, tenant IP preservation, and a staged operator-upgrade shim. Need input on gating and field requirements.
Devon L: Quick q — are we assuming customer does direct BGP peering or will we support NAT-relay fallback?
Priya R: Direct peering is the primary path, NAT-relay is a supported fallback with reduced guarantees. Draft includes both flows. Snippet: ```handshake: customer-bgp -> tls-tunnel -> control-plane```
Shawn K: We need an explicit rollback window for in-place upgrades. Proposal: 30min operator-shim rollback with automatic model fallback.
Katherine M: Also flag from field: customers want to preserve public egress IPs per-tenant. That breaks with autoscaling unless we provide pinned-eip mapping or external NAT. Add a clear migration flow for ephemeral -> pinned mapping.
Devon L: +1. Can we add a scriptable installer preflight so NetOps can validate before cutover? e.g. `./installer preflight --bgp-check --ip-pool --dns-probe`
Priya R: Yes — adding preflight hooks (console + telemetry). Failure modes surface with actionable remediation steps. Will include sample output in the doc.
ops-bot: preflight-report created 1765432380 for draft-runway (artifact: gs://redwood-private/preflight/1765432380.json)
Shawn K: Gating suggestion: field alpha only for customers with dedicated CIDR + NetOps engagement. No GA until we've validated with ~10 customers and one major cloud/edge topology each.
Katherine M: Agreed. I'll update the roadmap card with the gating criteria and timeline. @Shawn K can you drop rollback SLA numbers into the card? :thumbsup:
Priya R: Thanks — I'll incorporate and re-share. If folks can comment on the doc by EOD tomorrow that'd be great.
